name: INA219 current / voltage sensor breakout
description: Measures current (through a 0.1 Ohm shunt, up to 3.2 A) and bus voltage (up to 26 V) over I2C (0x40).
notes: High-side: put VIN+ / VIN- in series with the + wire of the load. Max 26 V, max 3.2 A with the 0.1 Ohm shunt.
Default address 0x40: the same as a PCA9685! Change one of them with the A0/A1 jumpers if both are on the bus.
VIN+ and VIN- are modelled as joined (0.1 Ohm); the shunt drops 0.1 V per amp.
Pull-ups (10 kOhm) to Vcc on the Adafruit board. Purple clone boards have a 0.1 Ohm R100 shunt too, check the marking.
